Uvaṭa
------------------------------------------
The language of the वेदस् is quite terse and archaic. Hence it is rather difficult to understand them without the help of standard commentaries.
Among the well-known commentators of the वेदस् who have made them easy to understand, उवट is also one. He was probably a ब्राह्मण from Kashmir. His ड़थेर् was Vajraṭa and he lived in the city of Avantī during the reign of the king भोज. He probably lived in A. D. 1042.
He has written a commentary on the Śukla यजुर्वेद Saṁhitā—also known as Vājasaneyī Saṁhitā—called Mantra-bhāṣya. The commentary is simple and clear, but follows the method of interpreting according to Vedic sacrificial termino-logy rather than philosophical concepts.
His other works are bhāṣyas or commentaries on the Ṛkprātiśākhya, Yajuḥprātiśākhya and Ṛksarvānukramaṇī.
See ANUKRAMAṆĪ and PRĀTIŚĀKHYA.
